note: The single source of the PAPER market state. Before this file existed, regime/paper_regime_reference.py emitted the string "UNKNOWN" as a hardcoded literal for every market and no production code called portfolio/paper_allocation_envelope.allocation_envelope(market_states=...) at all. This file names the source, gates it per market, and fails closed: a market that is absent from markets below, or whose adopted flag is not exactly true, is read as UNKNOWN. It authorizes a sizing INPUT and nothing else -- no buy, no order, no capital, no position size, no target weight, no real trading.

policy.note: Thresholds, axis definitions and symbol lists are NOT part of this binding and are unchanged. The policy's own authority block still carries runtime_regime_authorized: false, which is what regime/paper_regime_reference.py's policy validator enforces; that flag governs whether the REFERENCE POLICY grants runtime authority. The per-market grant in this file is the separate, user-ratified source binding, and it is the only thing that opens a market.
